items.title: Where the Scan Button Goes
items.why:
Now: "Scan a barcode" is the last button at the bottom of the Add food sheet, below Quick add and Add from a label, so it's easy to miss.

Each option moves it above the list, next to search. The button it replaces at the bottom goes away, so there's still one scan button on the sheet. It works the same: it opens the camera.

Pictures: phone (393 px), Lunch picked, nothing logged yet.

options.label: Full button above search
options.desc: Same big "Scan a barcode" button (52 px tall, full width), moved between the meal buttons and the search field. Most obvious. Pushes the food list down about 60 px.

options.label: "Scan" button beside search
options.desc: Search gets a bit narrower, with a "Scan" button and barcode picture on the same line. Easy to see; the list stays where it is.

options.label: Barcode picture inside search
options.desc: Just the barcode picture at the right end of the search field, no word. Tidiest, but easiest to miss and smallest to tap.

items.title: After I Build It
items.why: I'll build exactly what you picked, measure that the button is where you chose and opens the camera, rerun all the earlier checks, then publish it as 2.26.3.
